display_name: DURA 非线性幅度保持版源 IQ GPU 训练
description: 在冻结 DURA 的正交修正上，用源 clean IQ 的饱和非线性幅度响应辅助训练；不使用 F、TX 标签或目标。

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ, per-packet DURA and its estimated physical action

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Original DURA v1.0 stage2 E20/4940; zero-initialized new source-only orthogonal correction
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura verifies original7/63/30, training_F_access false, TX labels 0 and target_training false
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed DURA source-only original contract; no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5; no source or target performance selection

rows.method: DURA plus signed innovation and orthogonal IQ correction, source-only DURA guard and smooth nonlinear amplitude-response loss
rows.purpose: Train a distinct F-free recovery network at fixed five-epoch budget
rows.seed_notes: New model initialization 2026110612; source fit 2026110611, fixed input caches and DURA seed 2026092701; optimizer ordering 2026110613.

notes: One controller first runs real-checkpoint source smoke then source training; all predictions and independent scoring continue automatically.
No frozen-F weights or outputs enter source training; frozen F only read after model freeze for evaluation.
Source metrics never cancel any of the seven prespecified ground views.
Original DURA and previously user-stopped experiments are not changed.

Fixed loss adds 0.1 times mean squared difference in psi(z)=z*|z|^2/(1+|z|^2), with both z normalized by per-record clean IQ RMS, to source IQ and DURA guard terms. This is a waveform hypothesis, not proof of recovered transmitter features.
Same source IDs, seed, GPU, five epochs and architecture as dura_guard. Automatic full seven-view test regardless of source metrics.
